label: OpenRouter API key
description: From openrouter.ai/keys. Stored only in this browser's settings.

label: Model
description: Any OpenRouter model name. A small, cheap one is enough.

label: Provider order (optional)
description: Provider names tried in order, separated by commas. Empty: OpenRouter chooses. Other providers are used if these fail.

options.label: Tab groups (like the original Tidy Tabs)

label: Let the model pick an emoji icon for each new group
description: A folder gets it as its icon; a tab group gets it too with Advanced Tab Groups installed, otherwise the emoji leads its name.

label: Send each tab's site name along with its title (off: titles only)
Never send tabs from these sites
description: Words separated by commas: a tab whose address contains one is left alone and never leaves your computer.

label: Button on the line above the loose tabs (next to Clear)
